Class WorldBufferComponentAdapter

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.dod.WorldBufferComponentAdapter
public final class WorldBufferComponentAdapter extends Object
Adapter and diagnostic utility for WorldBuffer. Bridges Data-Oriented Design (SoA primitive arrays) with object component models and computes thermodynamic power flux and emergent technology diagnostics.
Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
